definition_text: A legal entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with another legal entity or shares common branding.
scope_note: Control defined as >50% ownership or power to vote.

definition_text: Data generated by automatic measurements of an individual's biological characteristics, such as a fingerprint, voiceprint, eye retina or iris, or other unique biological pattern or characteristic that is used to identify a specific individual.
scope_note: Excludes physical/digital photographs, video/audio recordings, or HIPAA data.

definition_text: A clear affirmative act signifying a consumer's freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous agreement to process personal data relating to the consumer.
scope_note: Excludes acceptance of general terms of use, hovering/pausing content, or dark patterns.

definition_text: An individual who is a resident of this state acting only in an individual or household context.
scope_note: Excludes an individual acting in a commercial or employment context.

definition_text: An individual or other person that, alone or jointly with others, determines the purpose and means of processing personal data.
A user interface designed or manipulated with the effect of substantially subverting or impairing user autonomy, decision-making, or choice.
scope_note: Includes practices referred to as dark patterns by the FTC.

definition_text: Any information, including sensitive data, that is linked or reasonably linkable to an identified or identifiable individual.
scope_note: Includes pseudonymous data if used with linking info. Excludes deidentified data or publicly available information.

definition_text: Information derived from technology... that directly identifies the specific location of an individual with precision and accuracy within a radius of 1,750 feet.
An operation or set of operations performed... on personal data, such as the collection, use, storage, disclosure, analysis, deletion, or modification of personal data.

Solely automated processing performed on personal data to evaluate, analyze, or predict personal aspects related to an identified or identifiable individual's economic situation, health, personal preferences, interests, reliability, behavior, location, or movements.

Any information that cannot be attributed to a specific individual without the use of additional information, provided that the additional information is kept separately and is subject to appropriate technical and organizational measures.
The sharing, disclosing, or transferring of personal data for monetary or other valuable consideration by the controller to a third party.
scope_note: Includes 'other valuable consideration' (broader than VCDPA). Exemptions: Processors, requested products, affiliates, intentional public disclosure.

definition_text: Personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, religious beliefs, mental or physical health diagnosis, sexuality, or citizenship or immigration status; Genetic or biometric data processed for uniquely identifying an individual; Personal data collected from a known child; Precise geolocation data.
scope_note: Requires Opt-In Consent. 'Known child' means under 13.

definition_text: Displaying to a consumer an advertisement that is selected based on personal data obtained from that consumer's activities over time and across nonaffiliated websites or online applications to predict the consumer's preferences or interests.
scope_note: Excludes ads based on current search, own website activity, or measuring ad performance.

definition_text: To verify through reasonable means that the consumer who is entitled to exercise the consumer's rights under Subchapter B is the same consumer exercising those consumer rights with respect to the personal data at issue.
Has the meaning assigned to the term by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (42 U.S.C. Section 1320d et seq.).
An individual younger than 13 years of age.
Has the meaning assigned to the term by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (42 U.S.C. Section 1320d et seq.).

defined_term: Decision That Produces a Legal or Similarly Significant Effect Concerning a Consumer
definition_text: A decision made by the controller that results in the provision or denial by the controller of financial and lending services; housing, insurance, or health care services; education enrollment; employment opportunities; criminal justice; or access to basic necessities, such as food and water.
Data that cannot reasonably be linked to an identified or identifiable individual, or a device linked to that individual.
Has the meaning assigned to the term by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (42 U.S.C. Section 1320d et seq.).

Any written, printed, or electronically recorded material maintained by a health care provider in the course of providing health care services to an individual that concerns the individual and the services provided.
scope_note: Includes the substance of confidential communications made to, or information otherwise acquired in confidence by, a health care provider.

definition_text: A consumer who can be readily identified, directly or indirectly.
An institution of higher education as defined by Section 61.003, Education Code; or a private or independent institution of higher education as defined by Section 61.003, Education Code.
A child under circumstances where a controller has actual knowledge of, or wilfully disregards, the child's age.
scope_note: Child means an individual younger than 13.

definition_text: A corporation organized under Chapters 20 and 22, Business Organizations Code; an organization exempt from federal taxation under Section 501(a), Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as a 501(c)(3), 501(c)(6), 501(c)(12), or 501(c)(19) organization; a political organization; or a 501(c)(4) organization described by Section 701.052(a), Insurance Code.

A party, committee, association, fund, or other organization, regardless of whether incorporated, that is organized and operated primarily for the purpose of influencing or attempting to influence the selection, nomination, election, or appointment of an individual to public office or a political organization office, or the election of a presidential/vice-presidential elector.
A person that processes personal data on behalf of a controller.
Has the meaning assigned to the term by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (42 U.S.C. Section 1320d et seq.).

Information that is lawfully made available through government records, or information that a business has a reasonable basis to believe is lawfully made available to the general public through widely distributed media, by a consumer, or by a person to whom a consumer has disclosed the information, unless the consumer has restricted the information to a specific audience.

A department, commission, board, office, council, authority, or other agency in any branch of state government that is created by the constitution or a statute of this state, including a university system or institution of higher education as defined by Section 61.003, Education Code.
A person, other than the consumer, the controller, the processor, or an affiliate of the controller or processor.

All forms and types of information, including business, scientific, technical, economic, or engineering information, and any formula, design, prototype, pattern, plan, compilation, program device, program, code, device, method, technique, process, procedure, financial data, or list of actual or potential customers or suppliers, whether tangible or intangible and whether or how stored, compiled, or memorialized, if the owner has taken reasonable measures to keep the information secret and it derives independent economic value from not being generally known or readily ascertainable.
